component.name: REV Hub Interface
component.summary: Test REV Expansion Hub motors, servos and sensors over USB

description.p: A Linux-native port of REV Robotics' REV Hub Interface for FTC teams. Connect a REV Expansion Hub over USB to prototype and troubleshoot without setting up a full robot control system.

ul.li: Drive DC motors and read encoder position, velocity and current
Position servos by pulse width or FTC position
Read the REV 2m Distance Sensor, Color Sensors V2/V3 and the built-in IMU
Set hub addresses and update Expansion Hub firmware

description.p: The hub's serial and USB devices must be accessible to your user; install the udev rule shipped in /app/share/revhub-interface once per computer.
